info.name: Digilux OTA — UC Test Collection
info.description:
25 use-case tests for the Digilux OTA system.

Base URL: https://iot.digilux.co.in/smarthome

Set variables before running:
  admin_token  — Cognito ID token for ota-admin user
  user_token   — Bearer access token with smarthome_server scopes (device owner)
  device_id    — registered device UUID
  version      — unique semver for your test run (e.g. 9.9.1)

See OTA_USE_CASE_TEST_CHECKLIST.md for full context.
